Below is a 4‑phase, 12–24 month sequence for the Methods Lab with clear objectives, subgoals, example deliverables, and decision gates at ~6, 12, 18, and 24 months.  
Phase 1 — Discovery & Benchmark Spec (0–6 mo): objective: define tractable, operational human‑centered metrics (trust, calibration, usefulness) and minimal benchmark tasks; subgoals: stakeholder/co‑design with Applications Lab, create synthetic and small real datasets, write evaluation protocols; deliverables: benchmark spec v0, 2–3 baseline implementations, IRB/data agreements; gate@6mo: advance if spec is approved and baselines show measurable room for method improvement.  
Phase 2 — Prototype Algorithms & Lab Validation (6–12 mo): objective: build 2–3 candidate human‑in‑the‑loop / uncertainty methods and validate in controlled studies; subgoals: algorithm engineering, reproducible experiment pipelines, pilot lab user studies with Apps Lab, ablation plans; deliverables: algorithm prototypes, reproducible notebooks, benchmark v1 and a tech report or internal paper; gate@12mo: advance if lab studies meet pre‑specified effect sizes or show clear paths to reach them.  
Phase 3 — Cross‑Domain Field Pilots & Robustness (12–18 mo): objective: test methods in 2+ applied pilots (e.g., education, public services) for external validity and scalability; subgoals: multi‑site user studies, stress tests, latency/scale profiling, safety/edge‑case analysis; deliverables: pilot reports, ablation studies, refined algorithms and integration plugins; gate@18mo: advance if pilots meet impact/acceptability thresholds and reproducibility checks pass.  
Phase 4 — Toolkit, Benchmark Release & Community Validation (18–24 mo): objective: finalize and release the Methods toolkit and public benchmark, plus drive community uptake; subgoals: harden APIs/SDK, prepare benchmark dataset + leaderboard, package docs, run a workshop or shared task; deliverables: open‑source toolkit, benchmark + evaluation server, case studies, publication; gate@24mo: public release only if safety/compliance audit completed, results reproduce, and at least one external partner commits to validation.
